The luz-ai release has one agent.

**`luz-agent-accessibility`**
- **What it does:** It reviews a web project's HTML, CSS and JavaScript for accessibility. It checks against WCAG 2.2 level AA and EN 301 549. Run it when a page or component is written or changed.
- **Access:** It reads source files only and writes nothing.
- **Fields:** None, so you don't fill in anything.
- **Assistants:** claude, gemini, codex.

**Still for you to check:** The agent reads source files only. It can't judge contrast as rendered, how a screen reader sounds, or whether labels and alt text make sense to a person. Those need a manual check.

To add it, run `/luz add luz-agent-accessibility`. I'll show a dry run first and write nothing until you say "go".
